validation.displayNameMin: Display name must be at least 2 characters
validation.newPasswordMin: New password must be at least 8 characters
validation.newPasswordComplex: Must include uppercase, lowercase, and a number
validation.aliasMin: Alias must be between 3 and 24 characters
validation.deleteWordMismatch: Please type DELETE in uppercase to confirm
validation.passwordRequired: Your password is required to confirm account deletion
validation.invalidSize: Image must be smaller than 5 MB

profile.cardDescription: Customize how you appear across study groups and course challenges.
profile.avatarHelper: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB. Click upload to preview & crop.
profile.displayNameHelper: Your primary name shown on study plans and certificates.
profile.emailHelper: Verified academic email address. Cannot be changed.
profile.academicCardDescription: Your verified university and faculty tied to your course catalog and syllabus engine.
profile.academicLockedNoticeBody: Your University and College are permanently locked after onboarding to preserve your course catalogs, syllabus databases, and leaderboard cohorts. To request an institutional transfer, please contact student support.
profile.collegeHelper: Your verified college or faculty within the university.

security.passwordCardDescription: Use a strong, unique password to protect your academic account.
security.currentPasswordHelper: Enter your existing password to authorize changes.
security.newPasswordHelper: Minimum 8 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers.
security.confirmPasswordHelper: Re-enter your new password for verification.
security.sessionsCardDescription: Manage active browsers and mobile apps signed into your StudyGenie account.
security.logoutAllHelper: Revoke all active JWT refresh tokens across other laptops, tablets, and phones.
security.logoutAllModalDesc: This will immediately terminate all active sessions on other devices and require signing in again.

study.availabilityCardDescription: Click or drag across hourly slots (06:00–24:00) to paint when you are free to study.
study.dragHint: Tip: Click and drag across slots to paint or erase multiple hours at once.
study.pomodoroCardDescription: Fine-tune your sprint intervals and recovery breaks for maximum retention.
study.focusDurationHelper: Length of each deep-work Pomodoro sprint (15–90 min).
study.shortBreakHelper: Quick breather between consecutive focus sessions (3–30 min).
study.longBreakHelper: Extended recharge after completing a full cycle (10–60 min).
study.sessionsCountHelper: Number of focus sprints required to trigger a long break (2–8).
study.goalsCardDescription: Configure daily study targets and automated exam-crunch prioritization.
study.dailyGoalHelper: Target hours of focused study per day across all courses.
study.survivalModeHelper: Prioritizes high-yield exam topics and compresses review intervals when exams approach.
study.survivalDaysHelper: Activate automatically X days before an upcoming exam (1–30 days).
study.regenerateModalDesc: Your schedule will be regenerated. Continue?

notifications.channelsCardDescription: Choose how StudyGenie reaches you when you are away from the app.
notifications.emailHelper: Receive weekly study digests and critical exam summaries via email.
notifications.pushHelper: Instant desktop and mobile browser alerts for upcoming study sessions.
notifications.eventsCardDescription: Customize which events trigger real-time reminders.
notifications.sessionReminderHelper: Get notified before a scheduled study block begins.
notifications.streakReminderHelper: Evening nudge if you haven't logged a focus session yet today.
notifications.examCountdownHelper: Alerts at 14, 7, 3, and 1 day before each registered exam.
notifications.challengeJoinersHelper: Notify me when classmates join my course study challenge.
notifications.quietHoursCardDescription: Mute all non-urgent push notifications and sounds during sleep hours.
notifications.quietHoursToggleHelper: Automatically silence notifications between the configured times.

privacy.leaderboardCardDescription: Control how your study XP and rank are displayed to classmates.
privacy.showLeaderboardHelper: Allow classmates in your courses to see your XP rank and streak.
privacy.useAliasLabel: Use an Alias Instead of My Real Name
privacy.useAliasHelper: Hide your real name on public leaderboards behind a custom student handle.
privacy.aliasInputHelper: Visible to classmates when alias mode is active (3–24 characters).
privacy.experienceCardDescription: Control dark mode theme, celebration effects, UI motion, and Genie companion interactions.
privacy.darkModeHelper: Switch the application appearance between Modern Light and Night Focus dark theme.
privacy.soundsHelper: Play audio chimes when completing Pomodoro sprints, quizzes, and level-ups.
privacy.animationsHelper: Smooth layout transitions, confetti bursts, and progress ring animations.
privacy.genieReactionsHelper: Show animated Genie companion encouragement and contextual study tips.

courses.cardDescription: Manage exam dates and active challenge participation for your enrolled courses.
courses.leaveModalDesc: Are you sure you want to leave the study challenge for {{course}}? Your shared leaderboard rank for this course will be reset.
courses.emptyDescription: You haven't joined any course challenges yet. Upload a syllabus on the Courses page to generate your AI study plan.

language.cardDescription: Set your preferred interface language, time zone, and calendar conventions.
language.languageHelper: Switches the entire application between English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL).
language.timezoneHelper: Used to schedule study blocks, exam countdowns, and quiet hours accurately.
language.timeFormatHelper: Choose between 12-hour (AM/PM) or 24-hour clock across your planner.
language.firstDayHelper: Starting day for your weekly study calendar and availability grid.

data.pdfsCardDescription: View and manage PDF documents processed by the StudyGenie AI syllabus engine.
data.deletePdfModalDesc: Permanently remove "{{name}}" from your storage? Generated flashcards remain intact.
data.emptyPdfsDesc: All syllabus PDFs and lecture notes you upload will appear here.
data.exportCardDescription: Download a complete copy of your study profile, preferences, courses, and progress.
data.exportHelper: Generates a portable JSON archive containing all your personal account records.
data.dangerCardDescription: Irreversible actions that permanently affect your StudyGenie account.
data.deleteAccountHelper: Erases your profile, study plans, flashcards, XP history, and uploaded files forever.
data.deleteModalWarning: This action cannot be undone. All your courses, AI study schedules, flashcards, streaks, and uploaded PDFs will be permanently erased.
